product.description:
Overview:

1. Pretty creative uses- combine finger spinner with a keychain.

2. Safety sensory for everyone- Great for fidgeting, anxiety, focus, ADHD, autism, and quitting bad habits.

3. Easy to use-Spinner the fidget toys are simply held with one finger spinner. 

4. Surprise gift for releasing anxiety, relaxing, staying awake, ADHD, autism, and other attention disorder issues.


Note: 

Only when the luminous key ring absorb enough light, can it be lighter in night. However, please don't expose it to strong sunlight for long time because if may get stained.

The product contains parts and small parts. Please pay more attention when your child plays to prevent accidental ingestion


Product Information:

Color: black, red, white, luminous green, luminous blue
Material: plastic/zinc alloy
Type: keychain
